name: Lacustrine-Moulin
description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed glass plains from ancient cataclysm in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.
The air carries ammonia and old snow, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
